name: Bound
idea: An aubergine kangaroo in full leap with a taped parcel riding in its pouch: big fast jumps, and your parcel stays safe.
why: It is a story people retell in one breath, 'the kangaroo with the box in its pouch', and it puts speed and safekeeping into a single picture.
risks: Kangaroos say Australia and Deliveroo already uses a kangaroo head in delivery, so the whole leaping body with its pouch parcel must always appear (never a head-only crop), the parcel shrinks to a dot below about 32 px, and a trademark search against other kangaroo-themed couriers is needed.
